status: draft - strike what is wrong before code
summary: Net-based radio, mesh, EW, drones, data and device suite for Arma 3. One RF base mod; everything else is a consumer. Voice phase 1: TFAR standalone as shipped (DLL + relay untouched) with our override layer - nets over its frequencies, its UI hidden, our tablet shows state, jamming/mesh per unit via its multipliers. Phase 2: trim the DLL for per-pair hearing, relay audio, voice notes. Nets, not frequencies.

decisions.decision: Voice phase 1 = TFAR standalone unmodified (DLL, relay, SQF, radio items) plus our override layer gfa_voice_tfrs: nets mapped to hidden frequencies, TFAR UI/hints/keybinds suppressed and replaced, state shown on our devices, RF link quality fed to TFAR's per-unit multipliers. No C++.
decisions.why: everything VON lacks (unlimited nets, two radios, static/fade, speaking indicators, our PTT) for SQF only; relay already proven

decisions.decision: Voice phase 2 = trim the standalone DLL: delete State/TFAR parser, add FEED contract (per-sender quality/position/effect), RECORD/NOTE for voice notes. Same relay. Alternative transport LiveKit if browser participants wanted. EOS hosted backup. No TeamSpeak, Mumble, Vivox, Agora, Gryt, VON.
decisions.why: per-pair hearing and relay-direction audio need the DLL; it is a trim not a port (applyAudibility already takes the list)

decisions.decision: Build order: RF -> voice override layer -> data -> devices -> EW -> drones/fires -> play test -> DLL trim -> hardware/hacking/AUGUR -> DIVINER swap.
decisions.why: all SQF until the DLL trim; gameplay and cost proven first

decisions.decision: Nets, not frequencies. The set manages frequencies (spread-spectrum MANET). Operator sees nets only.
RF is a base mod with no UI and no items. All other mods register nodes with it.
decisions.why: one link budget, one graph, one store

decisions.decision: Own radio family (MPU5 model) and own device family (vehicle set, tablet, phone, mini). No TFAR/ACRE radio classes.
decisions.why: fork keeps only the audio pipe

decisions.decision: No EWDJ dependency. Its detail level is the target; implementation is ours.
Key in fill = net membership. Captured fill = enemy can despread, DF, listen, jam that net. Rekey from admin panel.
decisions.why: whole crypto model in one rule

decisions.decision: Display mode is a CBA setting: fullscreen (today's widgets/map) or device (tablet/phone/mini/vehicle shells). Same apps on both.
Hardware keys: F1-F4 (app soft keys), left/right (cycle apps). No PTT key (PTT unit is separate). TIC on screen or mapped to F4.
AI->player hacking and enemy jamming are off until a module is placed.
Assistant name AUGUR, scoped: 'your AUGUR' / 'squad AUGUR'. Suggests one action at a time, never acts alone.
Jamming has three domains: voice, data, GPS. A jammer picks domains; RF applies them by band.

decisions.text: EW in the RF mod grouped as EA / EP / ES. New: spot/sweep jamming, GPS spoofing, decoys, EMCON levels, sector nulls, anti-spoof GPS, ES classification and threat warning, AI tasking from fixes. EW is both ways: AI uses the same EA/EP/ES rules against players (skill 0..3).

decisions.decision: Voice base = Arma 3 VON through one voice adapter interface (join, leave, quality, talking). VON adapter first; TFAR standalone adapter optional for real ear split; Enfusion VoN adapter for Arma 4. LiveKit dropped.
decisions.why: no install, no hosting, closest to Arma 4; RF, UI and rules carry over unchanged

decisions.decision: EW is its own mod gfa_ew on top of gfa_rf. RF keeps physics, keys, EMCON fields, noise-source hook and basic exposure. EW owns jammers, spoof, decoys, DF fusion, classification, threat warning, INSPECT/EXPLOIT, AI EW and comms gate, hardware power/heat/damage, RF app ES/EA/EP tabs. Separate EW app dropped.

Numpad: Ctrl+1-4 device F1-F4 (2026-10-21), plain 1-4 select net 1-4 by the number on the net chip (Select net 5-9 keybinds unbound by default), 0 / . device arrows (active net / cursor), 5 tablet, 6 radio app on carried device, 7/8 prev/next tab on small devices, 9 TIC. All CBA keybinds, player-rebindable.

AI EW skill per side 0-3, default 1 BASIC. Players use the DIVINER ISR trait for advanced EW. Comms gate the AI over RF links. Captured radios via INSPECT/EXPLOIT with zeroize chance. Faction radio tiers A/B/C, default B.

link_budget.formula: rx = tx + gTx + gRx - pathloss(d,band) - terrain - clutter - body; noise = floor(band) + sum(jammers in band, each - spread unless key held); snr = rx - noise; quality = clamp((snr - thr)/span)

mesh.vertices: nodes on net, on, relayCapable or endpoint
mesh.edges: link budget per pair, cached per tick
mesh.output: Link per receiver: quality, hops, lastHop
mesh.relay_cost: relaying node drains battery at txW while carrying traffic
mesh.gateway: node with two nets and relay=true creates edges between graphs
mesh.ai_nodes: only if profile.aiCounts or node flagged

df.rule: every enemy receiver in band with rx > rxSens gets a bearing; bearingErr = k / snr
df.fusion: 2+ cuts within window -> fix with error ellipse
df.named: true only if observer side holds net key
df.exposure: own emitter: fraction of enemy receivers currently above threshold; shown on EW app and radio app

ew.note: EW in the RF mod is grouped the doctrinal way: EA attacks, EP protects, ES listens. All three are rules on the same registry and link budget; no separate EW engine.

modes.barrage: whole band, noise added at every receiver in band; key holders subtract spreadGainDb
modes.spot: one net, needs an ES track on that net; +10 dB against that net, spread still applies but halved
modes.sweep: cycles bands every 5 s; each band gets full power one tick in four

drone_effect.soft_kill: data link quality < 0.2: AI drone drops waypoints and holds/RTB; player feed goes to static, control lost, auto RTB when link returns
drone_effect.hard_kill: optional, ewkit only: VIDEO band within hardKillRangeM at HIGH power cuts the engine

spoof.effect: unprotected GPS inside radius reports a position that drifts from true at driftMps up to maxOffsetM; own BFT dot and grid follow the false position; drones navigate on it
spoof.protected_sets: profile.gpsProtected = true: not fooled, shows GPS SUSPECT instead
spoof.detect: ES sees the spoofer as a GPS emitter like any other

deceive.decoy: emitter intent 'decoy' copies the band, power and duty cycle of a chosen profile; enemy ES makes a track for it and may DF it
deceive.fake_net: decoy can claim a net id; enemy without the key sees an unnamed comms track, with the key they see a member that never answers
deceive.limit: decoys carry no traffic and cannot relay

EA_electronic_attack.cyber: hacking addon actions (DISABLE / SPOOF / TAP) target rf nodes; DISABLE sets node off, SPOOF injects false BFT for that node, TAP gives the hacker side the node's net key for tapDurationS
EA_electronic_attack.other_mods: APS RF burst and IADS radars register as rf emitters (intent 'de' / 'radar') so ES sees them; their effects live in their own mods

EP_electronic_protection.keys: net key held = spread gain against jamming and ES cannot name the net (existing)
EP_electronic_protection.rekey: leader/admin rekey; a captured set keeps the old key only; rf_rekey (existing)
EP_electronic_protection.spread: profile.spreadGainDb: 0 legacy .. 30 MANET; stands in for frequency hopping

levels.1 REDUCED: power capped to 2 W, BFT beacon every 10 s
levels.2 MINIMISE: burst data only, no relay, voice on PTT only, beacon every 30 s
levels.3 SILENT: receive only; no BFT, no relay, no voice TX

emcon.scope: per node; leader can order a level for the group or net
emcon.effect: exposure and DF cuts drop with level; mesh loses this node as a relay at 2+

EP_electronic_protection.antenna: sector pattern gives gain inside the sector and a null outside: jammers off-axis are cut by sectorNullDb
EP_electronic_protection.gps: profile.gpsProtected resists spoofing; denial still works on it
EP_electronic_protection.pace: auto-switch to the PACE alternate when the active net is cut for paceAutoS (setting, 0 = manual)
EP_electronic_protection.mesh: widest path routes round jammed links (existing)

ES_electronic_support.intercept: every on node with profile.esCapable hears emitters above rxSens in its bands; feeds tracks for its side

df.rule: error grows as 1/snr; 2+ cuts in 30 s make a fix with an error ellipse (existing df section)

identify.named: observer side holds the net key: track shows the net and node
identify.classified: otherwise by band, power, duty cycle and intent: comms, data, video, jam, spoof, radar, decoy-looking
identify.decoys: classified as comms until a cut shows no traffic for decoyRevealS

threat_warning: new jammer or spoofer in reach
enemy DF on you: an enemy track on your node with 2+ cuts
ES_electronic_support.ai: enemy AI reads its side's tracks: a fix with 2+ cuts tasks a drone, patrol or fires to the fix (from ew-zones); EMCON 3 targets give nothing to fix

both_ways.rule: every EA, EP and ES rule applies to every side. AI uses the same emitters, keys, EMCON and tracks as players; nothing is player-only or AI-only.
both_ways.same_data: AI EW reads rf_tracks(side) and rf_emitters(side) for its own side; it gets no knowledge players on that side would not have
both_ways.same_effects: a player's set is jammed, spoofed and DF'd by AI exactly as an AI set is by a player

ai.gate: enemy EW off until the mission places it (DIVINER EW module or ALiVE-replacement profile); per-side CBA setting for skill

skill_levels.1 BASIC: static jammers only, ES reacts to fixes
skill_levels.3 SMART: spot-jams named nets, spoofs, decoys, EMCON and rekeys

EA.static_jammer: placed jammers barrage VHF/UHF/data/GPS around an objective (zones model retired)
EA.drone_defence: AI with a jammer spot-jams VIDEO when an ES track shows a player drone link inside range; hard kill if ewkit and close
EA.spot_jam: SMART: once AI ES has a fix on a player net, spot-jam that net (+10 dB) for jamWindowS, then move
EA.spoof: SMART: GPS spoofer around key sites; unprotected player sets drift
EA.decoy: SMART: decoys that draw player DF and fires
EA.cyber: AI hackers can target player nodes (hacking addon) at SMART

EP.emcon: AI groups run EMCON 1 by default, 3 when they know they are being DF'd or before an ambush; 0 in contact
EP.move_after_tx: AI radio operators relocate after transmitting for more than txMoveS
EP.rekey: SMART: when a set of theirs is captured, rekey the nets it held after rekeyDelayS
EP.pace: AI nets switch to the alternate when cut

ES.intercept: AI esCapable nodes (vehicles, EW teams, drones) build tracks on player emitters like player ES does

react.1 cut: alert nearby groups, look toward bearing
react.2+ cuts fix: task a drone, patrol or fires to the fix

ES.player_counter: players who run EMCON 3, move after transmitting or use sector antennas give AI less to fix

ai.player_feedback: every AI EW act is visible to players only through their own ES and effects: noise rise, GPS SUSPECT, DF ON YOU, drone link lost

ew.comms_gate: AI shares sightings, calls support and gets orders only over RF links; 2 s per hop; loss = 1-quality; <50 m voice always; isolated groups keep orders, try PACE, SMART seek high ground, fall back after timeout; LAMBS hook to check
